faq.heading: The problems every venue shares.
faq.sub: Here's how each one is solved.

items.q: Are you reprinting the menu over and over?
items.a: Price changed, an item ran out, a promotion started — the moment you change it in the panel it updates on the guest's phone. No printing, no waiting.

items.q: Can tourists not read your menu?
items.a: The menu is multilingual. Guests pick their own language, and the AI assistant answers their questions in it too.

items.q: Is your staff answering the same questions every day?
items.a: "Is this gluten-free? What time do you close?" — the AI assistant knows ingredients, allergens, hours and promotions, and answers day and night.

items.q: Are orders and tables hard to manage?
items.a: Whether the order comes from the guest's phone, the kiosk or the waiter, it lands in the same place. The kitchen display shows it, the till manages it, the ticket prints at its own station.

items.q: Do you know how your menu performs?
items.a: How many people viewed each item, how much it sold and how much profit it left — together with the cost that comes from the recipe.
